note: Machine-readable compatibility ledger: every compatibility scenario is tracked as pass / known-gap / not-applicable under a permanent hc-<suite>-<capability>-<case> id. Status, reason and recordedAt semantics follow ADR-0002 section 7; the ledger was established by T11 and absorbed the T09 known-gap records (tests/compat/types/expected-divergences.json). The hdunit suite (ADR-0006) adds one hc-hdunit-<subsystem>-coverage summary entry per hdunit subsystem; the per-file triage state lives in tests/happy-dom/triage/*.json (the truth source), and these entries only record the split counts.
